extension.name: Jira Mirror
extension.description: Spec Kit ↔ Jira bridge for team-managed and company-managed projects: configurable workflows & hierarchies (Scrum/SAFe), multi-project, idempotent and fail-closed. macOS/Linux/Windows.
extension.author: Fyloss

commands.name: speckit.jira-mirror.config
commands.description: Deterministic install ceremony — per-project metadata discovery, the managed README block, and a read-only verification of the lifecycle hooks the install registered, reported as separate effects.

commands.name: speckit.jira-mirror.feature
commands.description: Ticket-first feature naming — resolve or create the Jira ticket, then name the branch and flat spec folder by the developer's selected team convention; non-blocking before_specify step.

commands.name: speckit.jira-mirror.reconcile
commands.description: Mirror the current feature's spec-kit artifacts into Jira — the deterministic, non-blocking reconcile every after_* lifecycle event fires.

commands.name: speckit.jira-mirror.seed
commands.description: Seed a specification from named, existing Jira issues — validate the drafted pinning, confirm the write plan, then bind, create, and re-parent. Agent-invoked, after spec.md exists; bound to no hook event (a confirmation prompt cannot live in a lifecycle hook).

hooks.description: Resolve the Jira ticket and name the feature before creation.
Mirror the new specification into Jira Cloud.
Mirror the recorded clarifications into Jira Cloud.
Mirror the implementation plan into Jira Cloud.
Mirror the task breakdown into Jira Cloud.
